summary: The change does what was asked and passes. It raises MAX_CONCURRENCY_CEILING in athena-data's config from 8 to 16. I ran the range test: max_concurrency = 16 loads, and 17 is refused with an error containing '1 to 16'. All athena-data tests pass. I also ran the drain help tests (they pass) and `athena drain --help`, which now says 'at most 16' because the text is built from the constant. Athena's recorded checks for this tree show fmt, clippy and `cargo test --locked` all passed; I did not rerun them. In the design docs and the athena.toml comment, every max_concurrency and max_in_flight range now reads 1 to 16, while max_check_slots stays at 1 to 8. The value max_concurrency = 2 is unchanged. The new CHANGELOG entry sits under 'Changed' and describes only what this diff does. No xtask file and nothing for plan group-size recording is touched, and all six changed files are on the deliverables list. There is one nit: no test checks max_in_flight = 16 directly.
